item.title: The IoT Land
item.description: Subtitle: IoT Profit-Making Models and All-New Practices Author: (Japan) Kenichi Ohmae Translator: Zhu Yuewei Publisher: Beijing Times Chinese Press Co., Ltd. Publication Year: 2019-2-1 ISBN: 9787569932171 Notes: The author is a very famous management scholar; I have previously read another book of his, The Art of Thinking. This book mainly explains the importance of IoT and how to put IoT into practice to generate benefits.
